## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
- DD5: /dso:fp-recovery rejects PRs with OVER_BOUND status.

## Implementation Notes
Modify `plugins/dso/skills/fp-recovery/SKILL.md` AND any underlying workflow file at `plugins/dso/docs/workflows/FP-RECOVERY-WORKFLOW.md`:

1. Add a status pre-check at the entry point of /dso:fp-recovery:
   - Read the PR's review status (from the PR comment containing the OVER_BOUND marker, or from a sidecar artifact)
   - If status == OVER_BOUND: emit 'OVER_BOUND PRs are not eligible for FP-recovery \xe2\x80\x94 these require admin attention (chunking budget exceeded, not a false-positive)'. Exit non-zero.
   - Otherwise: proceed with existing FP-recovery flow.

2. Add a behavioral test asserting the rejection:
   - tests/scripts/test_fp_recovery_over_bound_rejection.sh
   - Given a PR comment containing 'OVER_BOUND: ...' marker
   - When /dso:fp-recovery is invoked (or its underlying script)
   - Then exits non-zero with 'OVER_BOUND PRs are not eligible for FP-recovery'

Add .test-index RED marker `[test_fp_recovery_over_bound_rejection]`.

## File Impact
| Source file | Action | Tests | Class |
|---|---|---|---|
| `plugins/dso/skills/fp-recovery/SKILL.md` | modify | (instruction; still-valid) | still-valid |
| `plugins/dso/docs/workflows/FP-RECOVERY-WORKFLOW.md` | modify | (workflow doc) | still-valid |
| `tests/scripts/test_fp_recovery_over_bound_rejection.sh` | create | (this IS the test) | needs-creation |
| `.test-index` | modify | n/a | marker |

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=\$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test) && [ -n "\$TEST_CMD" ] && \$TEST_CMD
- [ ] fp-recovery SKILL.md mentions OVER_BOUND rejection
  Verify: grep -q 'OVER_BOUND' plugins/dso/skills/fp-recovery/SKILL.md
- [ ] Behavioral test exists and is executable
  Verify: test -x tests/scripts/test_fp_recovery_over_bound_rejection.sh
- [ ] Test asserts non-zero exit on OVER_BOUND
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test_fp_recovery_over_bound_rejection.sh

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet); escalate.
